title: An almost necessary and sufficient condition for robust stability of closed-loop systems with disturbance observer
author: Hyungbo Shim; Nam H. Jo
locator: DOB closed-loop transfer functions and robust stability conditions under stated plant uncertainty and Q-filter assumptions
notes: Peer-reviewed theoretical study of robust stability for a class of SISO disturbance-observer-based control systems. Conditions rely on explicit assumptions about plant, nominal model, outer controller and Q-filter; do not reduce to a universal cutoff-frequency rule.
